# Etsy

> Etsy is a global marketplace for unique, handmade, and vintage items with comprehensive developer APIs and buyer protection programs.

Etsy provides both a consumer marketplace for buying and selling creative goods, as well as developer tools through its Open API v3 for third-party integrations. The platform emphasizes buyer protection and dispute resolution to ensure safe transactions.

## Key Topics

- Etsy API
- Open API v3
- Developer Portal
- Marketplace Integration
- Purchase Protection
- Buyer Protection
- Dispute Resolution
- Refund Policy
- Purchase Guarantee
- Shipping Issues
- Item Authenticity
- Customer Support

## Developer Resources

- [Developer Portal home](https://www.etsy.com/developers): Etsy API developer portal with Open API v3 documentation

## Buyer Protection & Support

- [Etsy Purchase Protection | Etsy](https://www.etsy.com/etsy-purchase-protection): Etsy Purchase Protection buyer guarantee and dispute resolution
